definitions.gloss: emphasizing; insisting on; stressing a point
definitions.explanation: The act of arguing or stating something forcefully and with conviction, trying to persuade others of its importance or truth.

examples.japanese: {教育|きょういく}の{重要性|じゅうようせい}を{力説|りきせつ}した。
examples.english: He emphasized the importance of education.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}は{会議|かいぎ}で{改革|かいかく}の{必要性|ひつようせい}を{力説|りきせつ}した。
examples.english: The president stressed the need for reform at the meeting.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{環境保護|かんきょうほご}の{大切|たいせつ}さを{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し{力説|りきせつ}してきた。
examples.english: She has repeatedly insisted on the importance of environmental protection.

notes: A compound of {力|りき} (force, power) + {説|せつ} (explanation, theory). Used when someone argues a point with particular passion or conviction. The typical pattern is ～を{力説|りきせつ}する. Similar to {強調|きょうちょう}する (to emphasize), but {力説|りきせつ} implies more personal conviction and persuasive effort, while {強調|きょうちょう} is more neutral emphasis.
